note: Region map for the zlOS fidelity oracle. Coordinates are REFERENCE coordinates and both images are scored in them, so the zlOS screenshot must be the same size. Read `derivation` before trusting any rect: EXACT means it came out of the mockup's source, PARTIAL means part of it did not.

regions.derivation: EXACT. ds.html's own $preview width/height.

PARTIAL. y and height are exact - the island's own top:8px / height:32px. Its WIDTH is not derivable from the source: 4 of its 10 flex children are text (Activities, the clock, the tray, the bell) and text width needs a font metric the file does not contain. So this is the full-width strip at the island's exact band; it necessarily includes wallpaper either side of the island, which dilutes the colour measures and does NOT dilute the structure measure.
EXACT. TOP = 48 is the mockup's own constant for 'chrome at the top' (it is what window drags clamp against). Every pixel of the island is inside it.

EXACT. 15 pinned tiles of 33px + a 1px separator with 2px side margins + one 33px 'show applications' button, 16 gaps of 5px, padding 5/7px and a 1px border (content-box, so padding and border add). w=629 h=45; centred (left:50% + translateX(-50%)) and bottom:9px. Every one of those numbers is read out of the style attribute; no text is measured because the dock contains none.
EXACT. DOCK = 62 is the mockup's own constant for 'chrome at the bottom'.

DERIVED. x,y are the mockup's own desk[] entry for /README. Content-box: width 68 + padding 4x2 + border 1x2 = 78. Height 38 icon + 5 gap + 13.65 label line (10.5px x 1.3 line-height) + 8x2 padding + 1x2 border = 74.65. The label line is the only rounded number here.

DERIVED. x,y are the mockup's own desk[] entry for /NOTES. Content-box: width 68 + padding 4x2 + border 1x2 = 78. Height 38 icon + 5 gap + 13.65 label line (10.5px x 1.3 line-height) + 8x2 padding + 1x2 border = 74.65. The label line is the only rounded number here.

DERIVED. x,y are the mockup's own desk[] entry for /kernel.zl. Content-box: width 68 + padding 4x2 + border 1x2 = 78. Height 38 icon + 5 gap + 13.65 label line (10.5px x 1.3 line-height) + 8x2 padding + 1x2 border = 74.65. The label line is the only rounded number here.
